title: 第488章 涅槃重生的杀伐
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
盛怒之下，欧阳冷傲爆发出虚空神剑杀向林雲，强横的金色神剑破开虚空一切阻挡，径直刺杀而来。
一道红色罡气风暴空间领域挡在林雲身前，虚空神剑一剑刺入空间领域。
众人望着虚空中欧阳冷傲、林雲两人的狂暴战斗，各个都屏住了呼吸。
沈飞龙不由自主的站了起来，神色极为复杂。林雲同样以空间领域来抵挡欧阳冷傲的虚空神剑，这输赢之间都会被拿来与沈飞龙作比较。
虚空神剑所在的空间都开始出现扭曲了，狂暴的空间神威不断的阻挡虚空神剑的杀入，让虚空神剑每一步前进都备受压力。
从虚空神剑传回来的能量感应，让欧阳冷傲感觉到林雲的实力竟然比沈飞龙还要强大，虚空神剑在林雲空间领域面前，居然没有任何优势。
“虚空神剑！爆！”欧阳冷傲大喝一声，持续不断给虚空神剑凝聚更多的圣境道则神威。可是如今林雲实力早已今非昔比，即使欧阳冷傲持续不断的释放出神威来凝聚虚空神剑，却依旧无法撼动林雲的空间防御。
欧阳庄主脸上表情比欧阳冷傲更加紧张，神威圣境八重天的强者，欧阳冷傲甚至能够感觉到林雲气息的强大。
“足足过去了一刻钟，虚空神剑竟没能破开林雲的空间领域，这到底是什么情况！”
“之前欧阳冷傲以虚空神剑击败沈飞龙的时候，只不过用了十息的时间。现在面对圣境一重天的林雲，却没有占得丝毫便宜。”
“想不到黑影大陆还有如此天赋异禀的家伙，难怪林雲能在试炼魔鬼之地中力压欧阳冷傲，拿到积分榜第一名！”
最为紧张的莫过于沈飞龙，同样的空间领域防御，林雲坚持了一刻钟都没有被欧阳冷傲的虚空神剑破开，而沈飞龙的空间领域在欧阳冷傲面前之坚持了十息而已。
沈飞龙虽然希望林雲击败欧阳冷傲，为三大家挽回面子，可是当林雲真的抵挡住虚空神剑之时，沈飞龙却又露出矛盾的思绪。
在众人的惊叹之中，虚空神剑与空间领域的对峙也接近了尾声。璀璨的金色虚空神剑开始晃动，金色神威隐隐朝着虚空中流失。
content_en:
In anger, Ouyang Lengao burst out with the Void Divine Sword to kill Lin Yun. The powerful golden divine sword broke through all obstacles in the void and came straight for the assassination.
A red energy storm space field blocked Lin Yun's body, and the Void Divine Sword pierced the space field.
Everyone held their breath as they looked at the violent battle between Ouyang Lengao and Lin Yun in the void.
Shen Feilong stood up involuntarily, his expression extremely complicated. Lin Yun also used the space domain to resist Ouyang Lengao's Void Divine Sword. Whether he won or lost, he would be compared with Shen Feilong.
The space where the Void Divine Sword is located has begun to become distorted. The violent spatial power constantly blocks the Void Divine Sword's entry, putting pressure on the Void Divine Sword every step forward.
The energy induction transmitted back from the Void Divine Sword made Ouyang Lengao feel that Lin Yun was even more powerful than Shen Feilong. The Void Divine Sword actually had no advantage in front of Lin Yun's space domain.
"Excalibur of the Void! Explode!" Ouyang Lengao shouted, and continued to condense more divine power of the Holy Realm into the Divine Sword of the Void. But now Lin Yun's strength is no longer what it used to be. Even though Ouyang Leng'ao continues to release his divine power to condense the Void Divine Sword, he still cannot shake Lin Yun's space defense.
The expression on the face of Master Ouyang was even more nervous than that of Ouyang Leng'ao. A strong man in the eighth level of the Divine Power Holy Realm, Ouyang Leng'ao could even feel the power of Lin Yun's aura.
"A full quarter of an hour has passed, and the Void Divine Sword has failed to break through Lin Yun's space domain. What is going on!"
"When Ouyang Lengao defeated Shen Feilong with the Void Divine Sword before, it only took ten breaths. Now facing Lin Yun, who is in the first level of the Holy Realm, he did not take any advantage."
"I didn't expect there to be such a talented guy in the Black Shadow Continent. No wonder Lin Yun was able to defeat Ouyang Leng'ao in the Devil's Trial Land and get the first place in the standings!"
The most nervous person was Shen Feilong. With the same space domain defense, Lin Yun persisted for a quarter of an hour without being broken by Ouyang Lengao's Void Divine Sword, while Shen Feilong's space domain only lasted ten breaths in front of Ouyang Lengao.
Although Shen Feilong hoped that Lin Yun would defeat Ouyang Lengao and save face for the three families, when Lin Yun really resisted the Void Divine Sword, Shen Feilong showed conflicting thoughts.
Amid everyone's amazement, the confrontation between the Void Divine Sword and the Space Realm came to an end. The bright golden Void Divine Sword began to shake, and the golden divine power faintly drained towards the void.
